stem.text: Which statement about the oxides of nitrogen is correct?

A.text: During lightning storms, atmospheric oxygen and nitrogen combine to form oxides of nitrogen.

B.text: In a catalytic converter, nitrogen monoxide is removed by reaction with carbon dioxide.

C.text: In car engines, the restricted supply of oxygen eliminates the possibility of the formation of oxides of nitrogen.

D.text: In the atmosphere, nitrogen monoxide reacts with sulfur dioxide to produce sulfur trioxide.
